description: Example denylist/allowlist extension for dev/staging. Copy to a writable path and set GOV_CORE_PII_POLICY_CONFIG.
warnings: Allowlist keys skip ALL redaction — only add stable identifiers, never free-text user fields.
Denylist keys mask string values only; nested objects still get heuristic scan unless the key is listed.
Do not commit production-specific keys to the repo; use env-specific copies outside git.
